about: Every functional (FR) and non-functional (NFR) requirement of the five PRDs (Claude Docs, see tasks/reviews/release-1.0.md), for the 1.0 traceability report (scripts/traceability.mjs, T106). edition: where the feature ships (BUILD-PLAN §13); a free requirement needs a test in this repo, a pro one in this repo or the Pro repo. A requirement with `check` has no automated test, for the reason and decision given.

requirements.title: Map the site's events collection and its start, end, timezone and venue fields; check it with schema:read
Booking settings stored per entry in eventConfigs, keyed by entry id
Ticket types: price in minor units, capacity, sale window, min/max per order, sort order
Atomic inventory: one reserved counter per ticket type, occurrence and event; undo earlier steps on a miss
Checkout in two calls: checkout/reserve and checkout/continue
Holds of 15 min (free) or 35 min (paid), extended per step up to 60 min; swept every 5 min
256-bit booking access token, stored only as its SHA-256, never in a plugin route URL
Confirmation, reminder, broadcast, waitlist and refund emails through a retrying outbox
Booking and event calendar files behind short-lived signed links
schema.org Event JSON-LD with offers and availability via page:metadata
Admin pages (Bookings, Attendees/Check-in, Settings; Pro: Promo codes) and CSV export
Signed waiver per attendee or per booking; check-in blocked until other adults sign
Stripe Checkout, signed webhook, refunds; a late payment re-reserves or refunds
Promo codes: percent, fixed and unlock (the only way to reveal hidden tickets)
Custom questions per event, with answers in exports
Waitlist with timed claim offers
Recurring events expanded in bounded windows
MCP tools: list events, availability, find booking, attendees, check in, cancel, refund
Dashboard widget with sold/capacity meters (Free) and a 30-day sales chart (Pro)
Configurable retention: booking personal data deleted 12 months after the event by default
≤ 50 ms CPU per route or hook invocation
≤ 10 subrequests (bridge calls) per invocation
reserved ≤ capacity always holds; reserved equals live bookings after a sweep
Public write routes use Turnstile (when configured) and are rate-limited per hashed IP
Stripe webhook replay changes nothing
Public responses carry no other buyer's personal data
Works on Cloudflare and Node with emdash >= 1.2.0 < 2
Times stored in UTC and shown in the event's IANA time zone
Versioned Markdown templates with {{field}} placeholders, a field list and a preview
Envelope statuses draft, sent, in progress, completed, declined, voided, expired
Immutable document snapshot per envelope with its SHA-256 (docSha256)
Ceremony: recorded consent, explicit intent, typed name or drawn strokes, field values
Hash-chained audit events plus a final envelope hash
Audit events hash salted commitments of personal fields
Signed PDF built once at completion, stored, with pdfSha256
Download returns the stored PDF byte for byte via a short-lived signed link
Hash verification route that returns no personal data
Invitation and completion emails, with links only
Admin pages: Envelopes (with audit timeline), Templates, Integrations, Settings
Integration clients with a pairing string shown once; revocation
Accept signing intents: HMAC, expiry, single-use nonce, return-URL allowlist; idempotent
Signed receipts; client-signed receipt lookup and template catalogue
Several signers with parallel or sequential order
Email OTP, limited to a set number of attempts
Decline, void and expiry (Free); automatic reminders (Pro)
Public self-serve templates embedded on a page
Uploaded PDF templates with fields stamped at entered coordinates
Bulk send
MCP tools: list templates, send, status, remind, void (destructive)
Retention: personal data and signed records on separate configurable periods
≤ 50 ms CPU per invocation
Signing and access tokens are 256-bit, stored only as hashes, never in a plugin route URL
Forged, expired or replayed intents and receipts are rejected
Return URLs must match the client's allowlist (same origin by default)
Template Markdown renders to sanitised HTML with no script execution
The audit chain verifies after the retention purge
The product never claims more than simple electronic signatures

Consent checkbox showing the versioned consent wording from the core
Signature pad: pointer events to normalised vector strokes, Clear and Undo
Typed signature, always available
Form fields from the template's field list, validated before submit
Completion screen with the download link

Works at 320 px wide; pad usable in portrait on a phone

docs/protocol/esign-intent-v1.md with test vectors both cores run
Each token type has its own HMAC prefix
Intents expire within 30 minutes and never outlive the hold
Each intent nonce can be used once
Receipts travel in the URL fragment or a POST body, never a query string
Forwarding the same receipt twice changes nothing
A revoked client's intents and lookups are rejected immediately
